title: Strict quotient multiplication, original steps 3--4
statement: Fix $\ell,E$ and schemes $X,Y$ with the completed and finite coefficient sheaves and strict quotient notation of [def-trf-isomorphism-strict-quotient-models]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be an isomorphism. On the full category of flat-term K-flat complexes $Q$ over $\widehat R_Y$, let $C_g(Q)$ be the published strict finite pullback tower, with positive exponent $n+1$, and $D_Y(Q)$ its original strict quotient tower [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. There exists a natural strict tower isomorphism $j:C_g\simeq G_{\rm tow}D_Y$ whose map sends the sheafified finite unit generator associated to $x$ (restricted along the canonical comma arrow over $U\to X$) to $x$, and whose inverse sends $x$ to this very unit generator. The equations hold for every $Q,n,i,U,x$; linearity is the bundled completed-coefficient linearity of $j$.

proof.text: For each unbounded completed-coefficient complex Q and level n, use the existing completed-linear QuotientTensor.insertion on its actual finite reduction Q_n. Its uniquely specified section formula is precisely the canonical comma restriction of integralOperationsPullbackGenerator. The already proved insertion_isIso and insertion_naturality implementation lemmas in Sheaf.Paper.QuotientTensorInsertion give invertibility and naturality in finite complexes. These lemmas apply without any invertibility-of-ell hypothesis on the schemes; no scalar extension or sheafification is constructed again.

Prove compatibility with the published pullback transition, rather than substitute the auxiliary transition from the insertion module. Evaluate the two composites on a section x at U. Replace both insertions by their section formulas. The naturality square of the published pullback transition along proEtaleIsoCommaArrow moves its action past the restriction. Its defining generator equation, integralOperationsPullbackTransition_existsUnique, then identifies that action with the generator of the actual unrestrictedIntegralTransition applied to x. Applying the target restriction to this generator equation proves the required square.

Use NatTrans.ofOpSequence and the successor square to assemble the insertions into a strict tower map. Each component is invertible, so NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app makes the tower map invertible. Apply insertion_naturality to the finite reduction of a chain map to obtain a natural isomorphism on the category of all original complexes. Invert this natural isomorphism and whisker on the left by the full inclusion of good complexes. Its inverse section formula is the insertion formula itself. Evaluate the hom-inverse identity on x and substitute that formula to prove the forward multiplication formula. This produces exactly the isomorphism and both equations of the unchanged statement.

lean.statement:
theorem isomorphismStrictQuotientMultiplication
    {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g] :
    ∃ (j : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙
          integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E g ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙
          trfQuotientTowerFunctor l E Y ⋙ trfInverseImageTower l E g),
      (∀ (Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
        (U : X.ProEt)
        (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X i).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        (((j.hom.app Q).app (op n)).f i).val.app (op U)
            ((((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E g n).obj Q.obj).X i).val.map
              (proEtaleIsoCommaArrow g U).op
              (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E g n
                (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X i)
                ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U) x)) = x) ∧
      (∀ (Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ)
        (U : X.ProEt)
        (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X i).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        (((j.inv.app Q).app (op n)).f i).val.app (op U) x =
          ((((integralOperationsPullbackLevel l E g n).obj Q.obj).X i).val.map
            (proEtaleIsoCommaArrow g U).op
            (integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E g n
              (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X i)
              ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U) x)))
